slides.text: CHAPTER 1 · GRADE 4 · WEEK 1 Energy Causes Change Discovery / Evidence Where can we observe evidence of energy causing change? ENERGY CHANGE ? Unit 1 · Energy Transfer & Transformation 1

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE BQ TURN & TALK Big Question Where can we observe evidence of energy causing change? Keep it in mind all chapter. We will come back to it. Think: What is ONE change you have seen happen? 2

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N WRITE BQ Big Question — My first thinking Guided Notes p. 1 Where can we observe evidence of energy causing change? My first thinking Write 1–2 quick ideas. No wrong answer yet. 3

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE D OBSERVE What changed? Reader p. 1 — you walk into a dark room and flip a switch. DARK room hard to see BRIGHT room light fills the room Something became different. That is a change. 4

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE D TURN & TALK I notice… I wonder… I NOTICE The room is different now. Light is everywhere. I WONDER What made the light change so fast? Share one notice and one wonder with a partner. 5

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE D OBSERVE Electric Pencil Sharpener Observe the pencil BEFORE we sharpen it. BEFORE A dull pencil — tip is flat, and it is quiet. Look closely. What do you see? What do you hear? 6

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE D PREDICT Predict: what will change? Think before we turn it on. When the sharpener runs, the pencil will… get ____________________ Make a prediction. Say it to your partner. 7
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE D OBSERVE What changed? BEFORE dull tip · quiet AFTER shorter · sharper · humming CHANGES • the tip is sharper • the pencil is shorter • it makes a sound 8

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE D EXPLAIN How do we know energy was involved? Energy can be invisible. We look for the change. ENERGY CHANGE ? The pencil got shorter and sharper and made a sound. Those changes are clues that energy was involved. 9

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE V Vocabulary — Energy & Change Reader p. 1 TEACH VOCABULARY energy the ability to cause change ENERGY CHANGE Reader p. 1 TEACH VOCABULARY change to become different BEFORE AFTER Reader p. 1 10

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N WRITE V1 Vocabulary — Energy & Change Guided Notes · Reader p. 1 energy — the ability to cause _______ . change — to become _________ . Write the missing word in each blank. 11
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N CHECK V1 Vocabulary — Energy & Change Guided Notes · Reader p. 1 energy — the ability to cause change . change — to become different . change · different 12
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE R RECITE What is energy? Reader p. 1 Energy is the ability to cause change. Say it together: “Energy is the ability to cause change.” 13

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE R TRACE Look at the seashore Reader p. 2 — the seashore changes all around us. ENERGY CHANGE ? Read Reader p. 2. Waves move. Sand shifts. Water makes sound. What are these changes a clue about? 14

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N WRITE N1 Energy Causes Change Guided Notes · Reader pp. 1–2 Energy has the ability to cause change. When you see a change, you are seeing _________ of energy. Write the missing word in the sentence. Leave the last box of your model empty for now. 15

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N CHECK N1 Energy Causes Change Guided Notes · Reader pp. 1–2 Energy has the ability to cause change. When you see a change, you are seeing evidence of energy. ENERGY CHANGE EVIDENCE Now write the same word in the last box of your model. 16

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE R Energy has different forms Reader p. 3 — think of a spinning carousel. motion sound light heat electrical energy On the carousel, the horses spin and move up and down. That is motion. Find the other forms in the Reader. 17
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C OBSERVE Clap three times What forms of energy do you observe? When you clap… What do you SEE? What do you HEAR? What do you FEEL in your hands? 18

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N WRITE N2 Energy Occurs in Different Forms Guided Notes · Reader p. 3 Write one example that shows a change for each form. FORM ONE EXAMPLE THAT SHOWS A CHANGE motion sound light heat electrical energy 19
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE V Vocabulary — Stored Energy Reader p. 4 TEACH VOCABULARY stored energy energy that has the ability to cause change at a later time STILL LATER CHANGE Reader p. 4 20

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N WRITE V2 Vocabulary — Stored Energy Guided Notes · Reader p. 4 stored energy — energy that has the ability to cause change at a ______ time. Write the missing word in the blank. 21
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N CHECK V2 Vocabulary — Stored Energy Guided Notes · Reader p. 4 stored energy — energy that has the ability to cause change at a later time. later 22

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE R PREDICT Does a still battery have energy? Reader p. 4 — think about a battery inside a flashlight. A battery sits still in a flashlight that is switched off. Yes or no? Make a prediction. Tell your partner why. 23

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE R The stored energy of position Reader p. 5 — an object held up can cause a change later. Raised apple → let go → ? An apple held above the ground has stored energy because of its position. Imagine you let go. What will happen? 24

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE R TRACE Stored energy can cause a change later Reader p. 4 — back to our battery: the chemicals inside it store energy. STORED ENERGY RELEASE CHANGE Stretch a rubber band — it now stores energy. Let it go. What change will you see and hear? 25

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N WRITE N3 Objects Can Store Energy Guided Notes · Reader pp. 4–5 STORED ENERGY RELEASE CHANGE EXAMPLE WHAT CHANGE COULD HAPPEN LATER? battery (in a flashlight) stretched rubber band raised object (apple) Objects also have stored energy because of their ________ . 26

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N CHECK N3 Objects Can Store Energy Guided Notes · Reader pp. 4–5 STORED ENERGY RELEASE CHANGE EXAMPLE WHAT CHANGE COULD HAPPEN LATER? battery (in a flashlight) the flashlight lights up stretched rubber band it snaps and makes a sound raised object (apple) it falls down Objects also have stored energy because of their position . position · Sample answers shown - yo

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE R EVIDENCE Recognizing evidence Reader pp. 1–5 — think about the clues we can see, hear, or feel. Energy can be invisible. What clues could show that energy is at work? Think of a change you have seen. What did you see, hear, or feel? 28

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N DRAW N4 Recognizing Evidence Guided Notes · Reader pp. 1–5 Draw a change you observed. Show what it looked like BEFORE and AFTER. BEFORE draw AFTER draw What changed? 29

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N WRITE N4 Check Your Thinking Guided Notes · Reader pp. 1–5 CHECK YOUR THINKING How do we know energy is involved if we cannot see energy itself? Start with: “We know because we see …” 30

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C CHECK We know because we see a change SAMPLE “We know because we see a change — like a ball starting to move or a light turning on.” Any change you observe is evidence of energy. 31
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C EVIDENCE Which change shows energy at work? A toy car starts to roll. A rock keeps sitting still. A room stays dark. Pick one. Tell your partner why. 32
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE N WRITE BQ BQ · Now I Think Guided Notes p. 3 BIG QUESTION Where can we observe evidence of energy causing change? Now I think… 33
CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C Review 1 — concept Energy is best described as — A a visible glow B something only batteries have C the ability to cause change D a kind of fuel 34

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C CHECK Review 1 — answer Energy is best described as — A a visible glow B something only batteries have C the ability to cause change D a kind of fuel Energy is the ability to cause change (Reader p. 1). 35

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C Review 2 — visual A pencil is dull, then you sharpen it. What change do you observe? A It gets shorter and sharper B It gets longer C It changes color D It disappears 36

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C CHECK Review 2 — answer A pencil is dull, then you sharpen it. What change do you observe? A It gets shorter and sharper B It gets longer C It changes color D It disappears The pencil becomes shorter and sharper — a change. 37

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C Review 3 — scenario Which object has stored energy that can cause a change LATER? A A ball already rolling B A toy already moving C A flashlight already on D A stretched rubber band 38

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C CHECK Review 3 — answer Which object has stored energy that can cause a change LATER? A A ball already rolling B A toy already moving C A flashlight already on D A stretched rubber band The rubber band stores energy; it changes when released. 39

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C Review 4 — comparison A carousel spins and plays music. Which two forms of energy come from the spinning and the music? A only light B motion and sound C motion and silence D sound and stillness 40

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C CHECK Review 4 — answer A carousel spins and plays music. Which two forms of energy come from the spinning and the music? A only light B motion and sound C motion and silence D sound and stillness The spinning is motion; the music is sound (Reader p. 3). 41

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C Review 5 — concept How do we know energy is involved if we cannot see it? A We observe a change happen B Energy can always be seen C We guess without evidence D Nothing can change 42

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C CHECK Review 5 — answer How do we know energy is involved if we cannot see it? A We observe a change happen B Energy can always be seen C We guess without evidence D Nothing can change We see a change — like movement — as evidence. 43

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C Review 6 — scenario A battery sits still in a flashlight. Does it have energy? A No — still objects have no energy B Only when it is moving C Yes — stored energy that can cause change later D Only when the flashlight is on 44

CHAPTER 1 · ENERGY CAUSES CHANGE C CHECK Review 6 — answer A battery sits still in a flashlight. Does it have energy? A No — still objects have no energy B Only when it is moving C Yes — stored energy that can cause change later D Only when the flashlight is on A battery stores energy. It can cause a change later. 45
